authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL phutta explicitly gives Bshk phut fly/phit mosquito and Phalura phutto fly/phutti mosquito. The selected Phalura pūtī and regional Maiya/Ushojo phūtī/phūthī and Bhateri phūth mosquito forms match this lexical family, with loss or placement of aspiration, vowel length and final feminine-vowel variation retained as qualifications. Both fly and mosquito are documented within the family, so the survey mosquito sense is preserved; no local donor route or independent derivation from the abstract insignificant gloss is asserted. Mixed phīth pīlīl and other two-part responses are excluded. Exact response: pʰūtʰ.
